title: RP-HPLC for simultaneous determination of water-soluble vitamins in leafy vegetables using ultrasonicated acid hydrolysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38270-38280
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04911C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tikeshwari, Kamlesh Shrivas, Khushali Tandey, Ankita Tejwani, Arun Kumar Patel, Anuradha Sharma
This study presents a rapid and efficient RP-HPLC method for simultaneous separation and identification of water-soluble vitamins (B1, B2, B3, B6, and B9) in green leafy vegetables from Chhattisgarh, India.
